intents.name: order_status
intents.description: Customer asking about the status of their order or delivery
positive_examples: Can you check my delivery status?
negative_examples: I want to return this item

intents.name: refund_request
intents.description: Customer requesting a refund for a purchase
positive_examples: Can I get my money back?
negative_examples: I want to exchange this item
When will I get my refund?

intents.name: return_exchange
intents.description: Customer wants to return or exchange an item
positive_examples: I want to return this item
How do I return my order?
Can I exchange this for a different size?

intents.name: payment_issue
intents.description: Customer having problems with payment or charges
positive_examples: Why was I charged this amount?
negative_examples: I want to change my payment method

intents.name: account_access
intents.description: Customer having trouble accessing their account
negative_examples: I want to close my account

intents.name: product_issue
intents.description: Customer reporting a problem with a product they received

intents.name: prime_video_issue
intents.description: Customer having issues with Prime Video streaming

intents.name: delivery_problem
intents.description: Customer reporting issues with delivery process

intents.name: prime_membership
intents.description: Customer asking about Prime membership or benefits

intents.name: general_inquiry
intents.description: General customer service questions that don't fit other categories

metadata.notes: Taxonomy based on analysis of AmazonHelp customer messages from the dataset. Intents are designed to be mutually exclusive and cover the majority of customer support scenarios.
